description: FEC Schedule A contributions (money INTO federal committees), AGGREGATED. Individual donors are never exposed as searchable per-record rows: the FEC sale-or-use rule (11 CFR 104.15) permits aggregated presentation only. NO NATURAL PERSON IS NAMED BY THIS TOOL, IN ANY MODE. A paid service ranking named individuals by their contribution history is a prohibited commercial use of contributor lists (11 CFR 104.15; 52 U.S.C. 30111(a)(4)). No contributor_name search and no street, city or ZIP, by design. Live from api.open.fec.gov with a cached fallback (source: live | cache). Three modes: (1) group_by: totals by employer, state, candidate, committee or cycle; on employer and state rows contribution_count counts contributions, not contributors. (2) leaderboard=true: top ORGANISATION donors in one scope, plus the individual side as count and total only, NO median and NO maximum, withheld entirely when fewer than 5 individuals gave. (3) entity_type or sub_id: per-record rows for non-individual contributors only. Modes and fields: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_fec_contributions

contributor_state.description: 2-letter state: leaderboard scope or per-record filter.

cycle.description: 2-year cycle, e.g. 2026. Required for leaderboard and employer/state; candidate defaults to the current one.

entity_type.description: Per-record mode, non-individual types only; IND, UNK and CAN (a candidate, a natural person) are refused.

exclude_memos.description: Per-record, default true: drop memo subtotals (they double-count).

group_by.description: employer/state need recipient_committee_id + cycle; cycle needs candidate_id or recipient_committee_id.

leaderboard.description: Top ORGANISATION donors in one scope, plus individual count and total only (NO median, NO maximum). Needs cycle + exactly one scope parameter.

max_amount.description: Per-record: inclusive upper bound on amount.

min_amount.description: Per-record: inclusive lower bound on amount. Rejected in leaderboard mode (its floor is a fixed $1,000).

sub_id.description: Per-record lookup; returned only if non-individual.

name: get_fec_contributions
